blocks.text: Ask me where to eat in Bondi and I'll give the same answer every time: the best table is one where you can smell the salt and hear the surf. From Sean Moran's dining room above North Bondi to a wood-fired pizza on Hall Street, here's my personal top ten - the places I send hungry friends to.

One honest caveat first: Bondi's food scene moves fast, and hours, menus and prices shift with the seasons. I've linked each venue's own page below - check the details there before you set your heart on a booking. Now, the good stuff.

blocks.title: Looking for more than ten?
blocks.text: This is my personal shortlist, but Bondi has well over 160 places to eat and drink. Browse the full [Bondi eat and drink directory](/bondi-eat-and-drink) and filter by cuisine, area, price or who you're with - date night, family, cheap eats - to find exactly the right table.
The special-occasion tables
1. Icebergs Dining Room and Bar

Perched above the ocean pool at the south end, [Icebergs Dining Room and Bar](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/icebergs-dining-room-and-bar) is the Bondi view everyone pictures - the pool below, the whole crescent of beach beyond. It's polished Italian, a genuine occasion and one of Bondi's great [date-night rooms](/bondi-eat-and-drink/date-night-bondi-beach). Book ahead and dress up; if the budget's tight, come for a drink at the bar and soak up the same view.
2. Sean's

Sean Moran has cooked on this North Bondi corner since 1993, and [Sean's](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/seans) is still my sentimental favourite. The menu is short, handwritten and driven by whatever's best that week, much of it from his own farm in the Blue Mountains. It feels less like a restaurant than being fed generously in someone's home.
3. North Bondi Fish

Right on Ramsgate Avenue with the sand at your feet, [North Bondi Fish](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/north-bondi-fish) is where I bring visitors who want seafood with a proper beach view. Oysters, whole fish, a crisp glass of white - long lunches here slide happily into the afternoon. It's my pick of Bondi's [beachfront and ocean-view tables](/bondi-eat-and-drink/waterfront-dining-bondi-beach).
Brunch, pizza and the everyday classics
4. bills, Bondi

Bill Granger's ricotta hotcakes and creamy scrambled eggs more or less wrote the rulebook for Sydney brunch, and the Hall Street [bills](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/bills-bondi-beach) room is bright, buzzy and reliably lovely. Yes, it's popular; yes, it's worth it - and it still sits near the top of my guide to [Bondi's best breakfast and brunch](/bondi-eat-and-drink/breakfast-brunch-bondi-beach).
5. Da Orazio Pizza + Porchetta

[Da Orazio Pizza + Porchetta](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/da-orazio-pizza-porchetta) is back on Hall Street, now with the little wine bar Orazietto next door. Blistered wood-fired pizza, that legendary porchetta and a properly Italian racket of a room - my go-to for a lively group dinner.
6. Bondi Trattoria

The "Tratt" - [Bondi Trattoria](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/bondi-trattoria) - is a Campbell Parade institution: pasta, pizza and people-watching from tables that spill toward the beach. It isn't reinventing anything; it's just a warm, dependable Italian that's fed locals for decades. I love it for an unfussy weeknight spaghetti.
Cafés, casual bites and something sweet
7. Speedos Cafe

Tucked at the quiet north end, [Speedos](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/speedos-cafe) is the classic post-swim café - acai bowls, big breakfasts and a health-leaning menu, steps from the sand near Ben Buckler. Grab a table outside and watch the ocean-pool crowd stroll by. It's one of my favourites among [Bondi's best cafés and coffee](/bondi-eat-and-drink/best-cafes-bondi-beach).
8. Porch and Parlour

Just around the corner, [Porch and Parlour](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/porch-and-parlour) has done generous, produce-led breakfasts and lunches for years. It's my pick when I want somewhere calmer than the main drag but still unmistakably North Bondi.
9. Totti's Bondi

The Merivale crowd's Bondi trattoria, [Totti's](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/tottis-bondi), is all about pillowy wood-fired bread and a table full of Italian sharing plates. A fun, boisterous room - best with friends and no plans for the afternoon.
10. Gelato Messina

No Bondi food day of mine ends without gelato, and [Gelato Messina](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/gelato-messina-bondi)'s Hall Street scoop shop is the reward after a long beach walk. The flavour board changes constantly, so just ask what's new - and for more sweet endings, see our guide to [Bondi's best bakeries and sweets](/bondi-eat-and-drink/bakeries-sweets-bondi-beach).

For beachfront tables at the popular spots - weekend brunch at bills, a sunset seat at North Bondi Fish - book a few days ahead or arrive on opening. Walk in at 12:30 on a sunny Saturday and you'll join the queue with everyone else.
Beyond the top ten

Ten is never quite enough in Bondi. When friends want something the list above doesn't cover - a cheap feed after the beach, a cold beer with a crowd, seafood without the white tablecloth - here's where I point them, with the full directory only a tap away.

items: Casual seafood: [Fish Shop](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/fish-shop) on Hall Street, or the tiny [Crabbe Hole](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/the-crabbe-hole) wedged beside the Icebergs pool for a coffee and a roll with the swimmers.
Cheap eats: a falafel wrap from [Sabbaba](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/sabbaba-bondi-beach) never misses - the rest of my [cheap eats](/bondi-eat-and-drink/cheap-eats-bondi-beach) picks are here.

A drink with the crowd: the corner rooftop at [Hotel Ravesis](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/hotel-ravesis), or a beer and a band at the [Beach Road Hotel](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/beach-road-hotel) - more in our [best bars](/bondi-eat-and-drink/best-bars-bondi-beach) and [Bondi pubs](/bondi-eat-and-drink/pubs-bondi-beach) guides.

blocks.title: Check before you go
blocks.text: Opening hours, session times and menus in Bondi change often. I've linked each venue's page in the directory - always confirm current details and book directly with the venue rather than trusting a number in any guide, including this one.

items.q: What is the most famous restaurant in Bondi Beach?
items.a: Icebergs Dining Room and Bar is the most iconic, thanks to its perch above the ocean pool and its sweeping view across the beach. Sean's and bills are close behind as long-standing institutions.

items.q: Where's the best breakfast or brunch in Bondi?
items.a: bills on Hall Street is the classic for hotcakes and scrambled eggs. For somewhere quieter, Porch and Parlour and Speedos Cafe at the north end do generous, produce-led breakfasts near the sand. See more in our [breakfast and brunch guide](/bondi-eat-and-drink/breakfast-brunch-bondi-beach).

items.q: Do I need to book restaurants in Bondi?
items.a: For the sit-down favourites - Icebergs, Sean's, Da Orazio and Totti's - yes, especially on weekends and in summer. Cafés like Speedos and Porch and Parlour are walk-in, but expect a wait at peak brunch times.

items.q: Where can I eat with a beach view in Bondi?
items.a: North Bondi Fish sits right on the sand at Ramsgate Avenue, and Icebergs overlooks the ocean pool at the south end. Bondi Trattoria's front tables also look out to the water - our [beachfront and ocean-view dining guide](/bondi-eat-and-drink/waterfront-dining-bondi-beach) rounds up the rest.

items.q: Is there good pizza in Bondi?
items.a: Da Orazio Pizza + Porchetta on Hall Street is the local benchmark for wood-fired pizza. Bondi Trattoria and Totti's are also solid for a relaxed Italian dinner.

items.q: Are there good vegan or vegetarian options in Bondi?
items.a: Plenty - Bondi is one of Sydney's better neighbourhoods for plant-based eating, from acai and smoothie bowls to full vegan menus. Our [vegan and vegetarian guide](/bondi-eat-and-drink/vegan-vegetarian-bondi-beach) has the current picks.

blocks.text: That's my ten, plus a few more for good measure - splurge-worthy views, honest neighbourhood classics and a scoop of gelato to finish. Eat from the north end to the south and you'll have tasted the real Bondi, salt air and all. When you want to go deeper, the [full eat-and-drink directory](/bondi-eat-and-drink) has every table on the beach.
